description: This Java class 'WorkingDaysUtil' provides utility methods for handling working days and non-working days, including date offset calculations based on working day schedules and repayment rescheduling types within the Fineract project.

classes.name: WorkingDaysUtil
classes.description: Utility class for handling working days and date adjustments related to repayment scheduling.

methods.name: getOffSetDateIfNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Calculates the appropriate date offset if the given date is a non-working day, based on the working days configuration and rescheduling type.

methods.name: isWorkingDay
methods.description: Checks if a given date is a working day according to the working days schedule.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Checks if a given date is a non-working day according to the working days schedule.

methods.name: updateWorkingDayIfRepaymentDateIsNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Updates the repayment date in the DTO if it falls on a non-working day, adjusting it accordingly.

methods.name: getRepaymentRescheduleType
methods.description: Retrieves the rescheduling type for a given working days configuration.
